subject: Electrolyte-NRTL model
source_sentence: A comparison is made with the methods proposed by Belvèze et al.39 and Akbari et al.40, as presented in Table 4. Belvèze et al.39 predicted activity coefficients of alkyl ammonium Quats using the Electrolyte-NRTL model. The model was analyzed in conjunction with experimental data for 32 different Quats. The interaction parameters between these specific salt types and water were determined. Based on a dataset of 767 data points, a mean percentage absolute error (%MAPE) of 2.91% was yielded. For individual substances, the lowest %MAPE was 0.37%, while the highest was 9.64%. While Akbari et al.40 predicted activity coefficients of alkyl ammonium Quats using the Extended UNIQUAC model. The model was employed to analyze experimental data for 36 different Quats. Based on a dataset of 1,007 data points, a mean percentage absolute error (%MAPE) of 3.16% was yielded. For individual substances, the lowest %MAPE was 0.19%, while the highest was 9.23.
